package.name: jr_ros2_control
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for CyberBeast joint modules (CYBERBEAST protocol over CAN/CAN-FD). Exports position/velocity/effort plus the MIT gains (kp/kd as wire values, or stiffness/damping in SI units) and supports two tick sources: an internal realtime loop (default, decouples CAN rate from the controller_manager rate) or the controller_manager update thread (simplest, single time base).
